About this item

  • Highly Scented: This Premium Fragrance features a lush blend of rich Madagascar Vanilla, fresh Cream, and a hint of Bourbon - an exotic take on a much-loved classic
  • Perfect Gift: Exquisitely packaged, the gold-foiled artisan-designed gift box paired with its monochromatic style will be sure to impress friends and loved ones
  • Long-Lasting: With a burn time of up to 40 hours, these large three-wick jar candles will burn long and strong. Easily extinguish the flames with the complementary soft-close golden lid
  • Natural Soy Wax: Proudly made with 100% soy wax, high-quality cotton wicks, and expertly made fragrances - our candles were created to offer a healthier option for home fragrance lovers
  • Excellent Decoration: From the premium functional glass to the thoughtfully selected color scheme, this scented candle will be a great home decoration

Product description

Gift-Ready with Fitted Lid

Includes matching lid. Ideal for housewarming and everyday gifting.

  • What is this candle and what is it designed for?

    This luxury vanilla soy candle is designed for indoor home use to create a calm, comfortable, and relaxing atmosphere in everyday living spaces. It is a large three-wick jar candle made with 100% natural soy wax, built to burn evenly and consistently

  • How does the three-wick design work?

    The three-wick design provides better heat distribution and a more balanced melt pool than single-wick candles, helping fragrance spread more evenly across the room.

  • What makes the vanilla scent different from other candles?

    The vanilla scent is intentionally subtle and refined, designed to feel warm and comforting without becoming overpowering like many scented candles. Focused on a smooth, controlled fragrance experience that stays pleasant during longer burn sessions.

  • How long does the candle burn and what problem does it solve?

    Burn time is up to 50 hours under normal use conditions, making it suitable for repeated, everyday use rather than occasional lighting only. This candle helps solve the problem of harsh, overpowering scents with a controlled fragrance experience

  • How does this candle support relaxation and when is it especially useful?

    The supports aromatherapy-style relaxation by combining soft light and a gentle vanilla scent to create a calmer, more inviting environment. It is useful when unwinding at night, slowing down after a long day, or making a space feel comfortable

Subtle Vanilla, Everyday Comfort

Clean, Even 3-Wick Performance

100% natural soy wax. Three wicks for balanced heat and smooth melt.

  • Where can this candle be used?

    Designed for use in living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, home offices, and other indoor spaces where ambiance matters.

  • What are the benefits of the soy wax and how do you clean it?

    Made with natural soy wax that burns cleanly and is easier to clean than many traditional waxes. Small wax drips can be cleaned using standard household methods once fully cooled. The candle includes a fitted lid to protect from dust

  • Who is this candle suitable for and how does it fit with home décor?

    It is suitable for adults who want a neutral, widely appealing scent that fits seamlessly into modern home décor. The clean glass jar design makes it easy to display without clashing with surrounding décor.

  • Is this candle suitable as a gift and for what occasions?

    It works well as a housewarming gift, host gift, or everyday gift due to its subtle scent and non-seasonal design. Designed for year-round use, with a vanilla profile that feels appropriate in both cozy and everyday home settings.

  • What activities does this candle pair well with?

    Pairs naturally with self-care routines, reading time, bath rituals, quiet work sessions, and relaxed evenings at home.

      This was a wonderful smelling candle. The wicked burned evenly and smoothly. It arrived beautifully packaged and the glass was nicely decorated. My only issue is that it burned for half the time stated. I burned the candle from noon till 10pm for two days straight and that was the end of it. That was 10 hours each day for a total of twenty hours. This is the first time trying this company’s candle. I purchased 2 candles. I’ve lit the second candle and will come back to give an update. The description stated it burns for 50 hours. That’s one reason why I purchased the 2 candles in the first place. We LOVE candles and light them almost everyday in our home so when I saw 50 hours, I expected to get something close to that burn time. So far this candle hasn’t burned half the time stated. Will see how the second candle burns. Other than that, we love the candle but will probably move on and try something else. Especially if the second candle burns the same way.

    About this Item

    • Highly Scented: This Premium Fragrance features a lush blend of rich Madagascar Vanilla, fresh Cream, and a hint of Bourbon - an exotic take on a much-loved classic
    • Perfect Gift: Exquisitely packaged, the gold-foiled artisan-designed gift box paired with its monochromatic style will be sure to impress friends and loved ones
    • Long-Lasting: With a burn time of up to 40 hours, these large three-wick jar candles will burn long and strong. Easily extinguish the flames with the complementary soft-close golden lid
    • Natural Soy Wax: Proudly made with 100% soy wax, high-quality cotton wicks, and expertly made fragrances - our candles were created to offer a healthier option for home fragrance lovers
    • Excellent Decoration: From the premium functional glass to the thoughtfully selected color scheme, this scented candle will be a great home decoration

    Product Description

    96NORTH Luxury 3-Wick Scented Soy Candle - Madagascar Vanilla Enjoy the deliciously sweet smell of vanilla scented candles. Made for gifting, this vanilla soy candle makes the perfect soy candle gift for women, or fancy candle gift. A simple yet elegant design combined with impeccable quality - this decorative white candle adds a neutral element of style along with a calming essence. Designed to meet all of your gift candle needs, our highly scented natural vanilla bean fragrance will provide the luxury candle vibe that any gift recipient would love - complete with a candle gift box. Perfect For: Birthday, Anniversary, Engagement, Bridesmaid, Valentines, Christmas, Special Occasions Product Details: Long Lasting Soy Wax, Three Wicks, Big/Giant/Huge Size, Aromatic Highly Scented Fragrance, Slow Burn Wax, Modern Style For Use In: Home Interior - Kitchen, Bathroom, Half Bath, Bedroom
